run_benchmark_indices_mapping: run the benchmark to measure performance of select, sort, shuffle, train_test_split, and shard on a HuggingFace dataset
benchmark_dataset_select: benchmark the select operation on a HuggingFace dataset by selecting every other row
benchmark_dataset_sort: benchmark the sort operation on a HuggingFace dataset by sorting on a numeric column
benchmark_dataset_shuffle: benchmark the shuffle operation on a HuggingFace dataset by shuffling all rows
benchmark_dataset_shard: benchmark the shard operation on a HuggingFace dataset by splitting into multiple shards
